page.layout: One page of text, with marginal notes in the right margin.

main_text.p: Græciam sive Peloponnesum, condiderunt Heraclidæ, sive posteri Herculis: Sed omnia in Historia Græcâ incerta & fabulosa, usq; ad initia Olympiadum.
Græci abrogatis regnis respublicas instituerunt.deinde liberas
Ex tot regnis duo tantum remanserunt, Spartanum & Macedonicum: reliqua omnia in liberas respublicas transmutata fuerunt.habuit.
main_text.head: Periodus II.
main_text.p: Philippus Rex Macedoniæ universam Græciam in unum iterum corpus redegit.posthæc in unū corpus redactū
Hujus Philippi maximæ fuerunt res, & ipse fundamenta jecit ejus Imperii, quod paulò post Alexan-der M.[?] constituit.

page.notes: The scan shows a printed "Cùm" with a large initial at the foot right; it is treated as the catchword. The running head "Imperiā" has a doubtful macron. The word "Alexan-der" at the line end is partly obscured; the final letters are uncertain. The marginal notes are small and were read from the scan; the note "habuit." is marked as uncertain in its punctuation. The number "17" is printed at the head right.
